items.summary: Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI. And it appears to be working remarkably well, with the company's models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago, with little indication of slowing down. That's according to a new report published Thursday by the AI safety research organization METR, following an 11-week investigation […]
items.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers

items.summary: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg. That would make it one of the world's most valuable companies, not long after raising $122 billion from investors in March at a valuation of $852 billion. Echoing FT and Wall Street Journal […]
items.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO

items.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
items.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation

items.summary: Greenlight Financial resolves more than 90% of up to 4,000 monthly security and risk cases without human intervention using Luna, a tiered multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post covers the architecture, episodic memory for continuous learning, and the expansion from SOC operations into financial risk triage.
items.title: How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

items.summary: Taxbit built Taxbit Assist, a cited, permission-aware AI assistant embedded in its enterprise dashboard, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post shows how they grounded answers in a curated knowledge base, enforced role-aware and region-compliant safety, and continuously measured answer quality on live production traffic.
items.title: Taxbit Assist: A grounded, role-aware AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

items.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.
items.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M

items.summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
items.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent

items.summary: As we built Amazon Quick, its agents grew from answering questions to taking actions, and the same primitives kept getting rebuilt under different names. This post shares the taxonomy we converged on — triggers, agents, capabilities, and learned context — found by decomposing agentic work into four plain questions: When, What, Who, and How.
items.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick

items.summary: An AI agent that acts for a user raises an identity question that per-app OAuth and service accounts leave open: which agent may act for which user, and how you stop it. In this first post of two, you build a task agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that governs access through Okta Cross App Access and AgentCore Identity, and enforces each user's authority.
items.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 1

items.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.
items.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
